Class UsernamePasswordCaptchaFormClient

java.lang.Object
org.pac4j.core.util.InitializableObject
org.pac4j.core.client.BaseClient
org.pac4j.core.client.IndirectClient
org.pac4j.core.ext.authentication.UsernamePasswordCaptchaFormClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.pac4j.core.client.Client
public class UsernamePasswordCaptchaFormClient extends org.pac4j.core.client.IndirectClient
Indirect client for form-based login with username, password, and captcha support. Handles redirection to login pages and error handling.
Author:
[@Loong Wan](https://github.com/loong10k)
